# FlashVAD

> FlashVAD is a small causal streaming voice activity detector for low-latency voice calls. The current checkpoint is an alpha research preview and is not approved for production.

Canonical site: https://flash.oss.codes/
Source code: https://github.com/oss-codes/flashvad
Model artifacts: https://huggingface.co/oss-codes/flashvad
Author: Himanshu Maurya

## Capabilities

- One speech probability every 10 ms
- Browser ONNX and WebAssembly demonstration
- Native Apple Accelerate runtime for macOS
- LiveKit Agents, Pipecat, PCMU, PCMA, and PCM16 integrations

## Important limits

- The retained checkpoint has a 26.3% false-alarm rate on the exploratory TEN public-set evaluation.
- Multilingual India and GCC production accuracy has not been validated.
- FlashVAD is acoustic VAD, not semantic end-of-turn detection.

Use the source repository and model card for exact benchmark scope, licences, checksums, and evaluation limitations.
